notes: Skills are plain Markdown. The bridge concatenates every .md file in this folder into the agent system prompt, in alphabetical order. Keep each file short enough to stay useful inside a context window; the loader stops at 60 KB.

skills.name: agent-contract
skills.purpose: Tool contract, allowed paths, edit budget, stop conditions, verification.

skills.name: imgui-reconstruction
skills.purpose: Mapping measured elements to ImGui widgets and ImDrawList primitives.

skills.name: pixel-forensics
skills.purpose: How measurements are produced, what they mean, and when to distrust them.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.purpose: Layout, type, colour and interaction rules for the reconstruction and the studio.

skills.name: unslop
skills.purpose: Anti-slop rules for prose, code, commits, UI copy and generated comments.
